name: Stack
layerWhy: It arranges other parts by space; it keeps no promise to the person of its own.
promise: Things one under the other, a known gap apart.
evidence: Strip every border and fill and the grouping still reads.
behaviour: A list as a stack drops its bullets.
context: Any group read top to bottom: a profile, a form's fields, a list of facts.
relationships: The gap says how related the parts are.
failures: Never a box to make a group.
